seoFallback.h1: Marklet — Free Online Markdown Editor, Share via Link
seoFallback.description: Marklet is a free online markdown editor with live preview. Write in Markdown and share your document as a self-contained URL — no sign-up, no account, no server required. Your content is encoded directly in the link.
seoFallback.feature1: Live markdown preview with split-pane editor
seoFallback.feature2: Share markdown documents as a URL link — no uploads, no storage
seoFallback.feature3: No sign-up or account needed — open the page and start writing
seoFallback.feature4: Optional end-to-end encrypted sharing for private content
seoFallback.feature5: Export markdown as PDF or HTML
seoFallback.feature6: Works offline as a Progressive Web App (PWA)
seoFallback.feature7: MCP server integration for AI-powered workflows
seoFallback.howDescription: Type your markdown in the editor. Marklet compresses and encodes your content directly into the URL. Copy the link and share it — anyone with the link can read your document instantly, no account required.
